# ASIO 1.38.2 (standalone, header-only)

Vendored copy of https://github.com/chriskohlhoff/asio (tag `asio-1-38-2`, `ASIO_VERSION 103802`).
Licensed under the Boost Software License 1.0 (see `LICENSE_1_0.txt`). No Boost dependency is used.
Only the `include/` directory is required; it is exposed by CMake as the `asio::asio` interface target.
